verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a first-party API reference with per-endpoint pages, such as Create Card and Create Cardholder, so the reference itself exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that it is interactive or that its examples can be run in-page. The simulated-purchase testing guides are a separate capability and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of interactivity in the reference, runnable or executable examples, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
